🎤 It started on my phone…

I recorded a bass line on my phone and wanted to make a song out of it! 🎶

🔈 🔊 100%

Too quiet? Slide the volume up! (Bass is hard to hear on laptop speakers — headphones help 🎧)

💥 The problem

To make a real song, I want to MIX it with other music — like DJs do!

🎯 My goal mix: 148 BPM
🎸 Song A: 136 BPM — The Rolling Stones, “Satisfaction” (original)
🕺 Song B: 152 BPM — Fatboy Slim, “The Rockafeller Skank” (original)

What if I just play the original songs together? 🤔 Press play and listen:

🔧 The fix: a SCALING FACTOR

I need to change each song’s speed so it hits 148. The number I multiply by is the scaling factor:

scaling factor = goaloriginal
🎸 Song A: 148136 = ? → bigger than 1 → speed UP ⏩
🕺 Song B: 148152 = ? → smaller than 1 → slow DOWN ⏪

✖️ × 1 = same speed  ·  × more than 1 = faster  ·  × less than 1 = slower

2

3
